fr.story.le_chat_et_la_souris.title: Le chat et la souris
fr.story.le_chat_et_la_souris.blurb: In Madame Dubois's house there is a cat — and a mouse who loves cheese.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Dans la maison de madame Dubois, il y a un chat.
sentences.translation: In Madame Dubois's house, there is a cat.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le chat aime le lait, le poisson et le poulet.
sentences.translation: The cat likes milk, fish and chicken.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le matin, il reste à la porte de la maison.
sentences.translation: In the morning, he stays by the door of the house.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, il reste sur la table.
sentences.translation: In the evening, he stays on the table.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais dans la maison, il y a aussi une souris.
sentences.translation: But in the house, there is also a mouse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un jour, madame Dubois achète un fromage au magasin.
sentences.translation: One day, Madame Dubois buys a cheese at the shop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le fromage est sur la table de la maison.
sentences.translation: The cheese is on the table in the house.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, la souris va sur la table.
sentences.translation: In the evening, the mouse goes onto the table.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le chat est là.
sentences.translation: The cat is there.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Attention, le chat !
sentences.translation: Watch out, the cat!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais le chat ne fait rien.
sentences.translation: But the cat does nothing.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il aime la souris.
sentences.translation: He likes the mouse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: La souris mange le fromage et le chat boit son lait.
sentences.translation: The mouse eats the cheese and the cat drinks his milk.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Madame Dubois parle avec le garçon de la maison, Paul.
sentences.translation: Madame Dubois talks to the boy of the house, Paul.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Paul, pourquoi le chat ne fait rien ?
sentences.translation: Paul, why does the cat do nothing?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Parce que le chat aime la vie avec elle.
sentences.translation: Because the cat likes life with her.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Quelle histoire !
sentences.translation: What a story!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un autre jour, madame Dubois va au magasin.
sentences.translation: Another day, Madame Dubois goes to the shop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle achète du lait pour le chat et du pain pour elle.
sentences.translation: She buys milk for the cat and bread for herself.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Et la porte de la maison reste ouverte.
sentences.translation: And the door of the house stays open.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Maintenant, ils habitent tous dans la maison de madame Dubois.
sentences.translation: Now they all live in Madame Dubois's house.

fr.story.le_cadeau_de_lea.title: Le cadeau de Léa
fr.story.le_cadeau_de_lea.blurb: Léa buys a present for her daughter in a little bookshop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Aujourd'hui, c'est samedi.
sentences.translation: Today is Saturday.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Léa veut acheter un cadeau pour sa fille, Emma.
sentences.translation: Léa wants to buy a present for her daughter, Emma.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Emma aime les histoires et les héros.
sentences.translation: Emma loves stories and heroes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Léa va dans une librairie de la rue.
sentences.translation: Léa goes into a bookshop on the street.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: La librairie est ouverte le samedi.
sentences.translation: The bookshop is open on Saturdays.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonjour, madame. Vous voulez une histoire ?
sentences.translation: Hello, madam. Would you like a story?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, une histoire pour ma fille. Elle aime les héros.
sentences.translation: Yes, a story for my daughter. She loves heroes.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Voici l'histoire d'un garçon et de son cheval.
sentences.translation: Here is the story of a boy and his horse.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: C'est un voyage de la ville à la plage.
sentences.translation: It's a journey from the city to the beach.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui ! Combien ça coûte ?
sentences.translation: Yes! How much is it?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Le prix est sur le papier.
sentences.translation: The price is on the paper.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Léa paie avec son argent.
sentences.translation: Léa pays with her money.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Voici votre monnaie, madame.
sentences.translation: Here is your change, madam.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Et ma fille aime aussi la musique.
sentences.translation: And my daughter loves music too.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Merci, monsieur. Au revoir !
sentences.translation: Thank you. Goodbye!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, Emma ouvre le cadeau.
sentences.translation: In the evening, Emma opens the present.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: C'est l'histoire du garçon et de son cheval.
sentences.translation: It's the story of the boy and his horse.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Merci ! J'aime beaucoup les chevaux.
sentences.translation: Thank you! I love horses.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Emma reste avec l'histoire tout le soir.
sentences.translation: Emma stays with the story all evening.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle aime le héros et son cheval.
sentences.translation: She loves the hero and his horse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le dimanche, elle parle du héros à toute la maison.
sentences.translation: On Sunday, she tells the whole house about the hero.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Demain, on va à la librairie ?
sentences.translation: Shall we go to the bookshop tomorrow?

fr.story.a_la_gare.title: À la gare
fr.story.a_la_gare.blurb: Hugo and Camille go to the station for a trip to the beach — but the train doesn't come.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hugo et Camille vont à la gare.
sentences.translation: Hugo and Camille go to the station.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils prennent le train de dix heures pour la plage.
sentences.translation: They're taking the ten o'clock train to the beach.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hugo a une valise, et Camille a deux valises.
sentences.translation: Hugo has one suitcase, and Camille has two.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Dans le taxi, Camille parle beaucoup.
sentences.translation: In the taxi, Camille talks a lot.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hugo, tu as les billets ?
sentences.translation: Hugo, have you got the tickets?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oui, j'ai les billets.
sentences.translation: Yes, I've got the tickets.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À la gare, il y a beaucoup d'hommes et de femmes.
sentences.translation: At the station there are lots of men and women.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Quelle voie ?
sentences.translation: Which platform?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Pardon, madame. C'est quelle voie pour le train de dix heures ?
sentences.translation: Excuse me, madam. Which platform is the ten o'clock train?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Voie trois, monsieur.
sentences.translation: Platform three, sir.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hugo et Camille vont à droite.
sentences.translation: Hugo and Camille go to the right.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais le train n'est pas là.
sentences.translation: But the train isn't there.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils attendent cinq minutes, puis dix minutes.
sentences.translation: They wait five minutes, then ten.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hugo, quelle heure est-il ?
sentences.translation: Hugo, what time is it?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Il est dix heures et cinq minutes.
sentences.translation: It's five past ten.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Une femme de la gare parle avec eux.
sentences.translation: A woman from the station talks to them.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Le départ du train est à onze heures aujourd'hui.
sentences.translation: Today the train leaves at eleven.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: À onze heures ? Pourquoi ?
sentences.translation: At eleven? Why?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Le train attend dans une autre ville.
sentences.translation: The train is waiting in another town.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hugo et Camille restent à la gare.
sentences.translation: Hugo and Camille stay at the station.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils prennent un café et un jus de pomme au restaurant de la gare.
sentences.translation: They have a coffee and an apple juice in the station restaurant.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À onze heures, le train est là.
sentences.translation: At eleven, the train is there.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hugo, c'est le départ !
sentences.translation: Hugo, we're leaving!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, ils sont à la plage.
sentences.translation: By evening, they're at the beach.

fr.story.le_cafe_du_matin.title: Le café du matin
fr.story.le_cafe_du_matin.blurb: Every morning a woman comes to Marc's café. Then one day she stops coming.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Marc travaille dans un restaurant de la place.
sentences.translation: Marc works in a restaurant on the square.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le restaurant ouvre à sept heures du matin.
sentences.translation: The restaurant opens at seven in the morning.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chaque matin, une femme prend un café et du pain.
sentences.translation: Every morning, a woman has a coffee and some bread.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle prend toujours la table près de la porte.
sentences.translation: She always takes the table by the door.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonjour, madame. Un café et du pain ?
sentences.translation: Good morning, madam. A coffee and some bread?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, s'il vous plaît. Et un œuf aussi.
sentences.translation: Yes, please. And an egg too.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle mange, elle boit son café et elle reste une heure.
sentences.translation: She eats, drinks her coffee and stays for an hour.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle a toujours un papier sur la table.
sentences.translation: She always has a sheet of paper on the table.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Marc ne parle pas beaucoup avec elle.
sentences.translation: Marc doesn't talk with her much.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un jour, la femme n'est pas là.
sentences.translation: One day, the woman isn't there.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un autre jour, elle n'est pas là non plus.
sentences.translation: Another day, she isn't there either.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Marc attend.
sentences.translation: Marc waits.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Une semaine après, la femme est à la porte.
sentences.translation: A week later, the woman is at the door.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonjour, madame ! Un café et un œuf ?
sentences.translation: Good morning, madam! A coffee and an egg?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, merci. Et voici un cadeau pour vous.
sentences.translation: Yes, thank you. And here is a present for you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: C'est un papier avec une histoire.
sentences.translation: It's a sheet of paper with a story.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: C'est l'histoire d'un homme dans un restaurant de la place.
sentences.translation: It's the story of a man in a restaurant on the square.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: C'est moi ?
sentences.translation: Is it me?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui. J'aime votre café et votre restaurant.
sentences.translation: Yes. I love your coffee and your restaurant.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, il y a un message sur la porte du restaurant.
sentences.translation: In the evening, there is a message on the restaurant door.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: « Merci pour le café. À demain. »
sentences.translation: "Thank you for the coffee. See you tomorrow."

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Marc aime beaucoup ce message.
sentences.translation: Marc loves that message.

sentences.translation: There is also a hen and a donkey.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le matin, la poule fait un œuf.
sentences.translation: In the morning, the hen lays an egg.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Monsieur Martin mange l'œuf avec du pain.
sentences.translation: Monsieur Martin eats the egg with bread.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: La vache fait du lait.
sentences.translation: The cow gives milk.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le chien reste à la porte et le chat reste à la table.
sentences.translation: The dog stays by the door and the cat stays by the table.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le cheval et l'âne travaillent avec monsieur Martin.
sentences.translation: The horse and the donkey work with Monsieur Martin.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un jour, un garçon de la ville est à la porte.
sentences.translation: One day, a boy from the city is at the door.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonjour, monsieur. Je suis Léo.
sentences.translation: Hello, sir. I'm Léo.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Je veux rester une semaine chez vous.
sentences.translation: I want to stay a week with you.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Une semaine ? Pourquoi ?
sentences.translation: A week? Why?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Parce que j'aime les chevaux et les vaches.
sentences.translation: Because I love horses and cows.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Monsieur Martin ouvre la porte.
sentences.translation: Monsieur Martin opens the door.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Pendant une semaine, Léo travaille avec lui.
sentences.translation: For a week, Léo works with him.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le matin, il prend les œufs.
sentences.translation: In the morning, he collects the eggs.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, il est avec le cheval.
sentences.translation: In the evening, he is with the horse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le dimanche, Léo prend le train pour la ville.
sentences.translation: On Sunday, Léo takes the train back to the city.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Merci, monsieur. C'est la vie que j'aime !
sentences.translation: Thank you, sir. This is the life I love!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Au revoir, Léo. La porte est toujours ouverte.
sentences.translation: Goodbye, Léo. The door is always open.

questions.prompt: Which animals does Monsieur Martin have?
options: A dog, a cat, a horse, a cow, a hen and a donkey
Only a dog and a cat

questions.prompt: How long does Léo stay?
What does Léo think of life at Monsieur Martin's?
options: He is afraid of the animals

fr.story.une_journee_a_la_plage.title: Une journée à la plage
fr.story.une_journee_a_la_plage.blurb: Julie and Antoine spend Sunday at the beach. A bird steals Julie's bread.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Aujourd'hui, c'est dimanche.
sentences.translation: Today is Sunday.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Julie et Antoine vont à la plage.
sentences.translation: Julie and Antoine go to the beach.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils prennent le train du matin.
sentences.translation: They take the morning train.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À la plage, il y a de l'eau, des hommes, des femmes et des chiens.
sentences.translation: At the beach there is water, there are men, women and dogs.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Antoine, quelle journée !
sentences.translation: Antoine, what a day!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Antoine va dans l'eau.
sentences.translation: Antoine goes into the water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Julie reste sur la plage avec un jus de fruit.
sentences.translation: Julie stays on the beach with a fruit juice.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un oiseau est près de Julie.
sentences.translation: A bird is near Julie.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: L'oiseau veut son pain.
sentences.translation: The bird wants her bread.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Non, non ! C'est mon pain !
sentences.translation: No, no! That's my bread!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais l'oiseau prend le pain et va sur l'eau.
sentences.translation: But the bird takes the bread and flies out over the water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Antoine est dans l'eau. Il aime la situation.
sentences.translation: Antoine is in the water. He enjoys the situation.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Julie, tu n'as pas de chance aujourd'hui !
sentences.translation: Julie, you're out of luck today!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Et toi, tu as un poisson ?
sentences.translation: And you — have you got a fish?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Non. Pas de poisson. Mais j'ai une solution.
sentences.translation: No. No fish. But I have a solution.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Antoine va au restaurant de la plage.
sentences.translation: Antoine goes to the beach restaurant.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il prend du poulet, du riz et deux jus de pomme.
sentences.translation: He gets chicken, rice and two apple juices.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils mangent à une table près de l'eau.
sentences.translation: They eat at a table near the water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un autre oiseau est là aussi.
sentences.translation: Another bird is there too.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pas de pain pour toi !
sentences.translation: No bread for you!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, Julie et Antoine prennent le train pour la ville.
sentences.translation: In the evening, Julie and Antoine take the train back to the city.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Merci pour le poulet, Antoine.
sentences.translation: Thanks for the chicken, Antoine.

questions.prompt: Where do Julie and Antoine go on Sunday?
options: To a restaurant in the city

questions.prompt: What does the bird take from Julie?
Why does Antoine go to the beach restaurant?
options: Because the bird took Julie's bread, so he buys other food

fr.story.le_message_du_patron.title: Le message du patron
fr.story.le_message_du_patron.blurb: Nicolas gets a message from his boss: there's trouble. He finds a solution.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Nicolas travaille dans un bureau en ville.
sentences.translation: Nicolas works in an office in town.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chaque matin, il prend le train de huit heures.
sentences.translation: Every morning, he takes the eight o'clock train.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Un jour, il a un message de son patron.
sentences.translation: One day, he gets a message from his boss.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: « Nicolas, il y a une question d'argent. Je vous attends. »
sentences.translation: "Nicolas, there's a question of money. I'm waiting for you."

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Nicolas prend un taxi pour aller en ville.
sentences.translation: Nicolas takes a taxi into town.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Dans le taxi, il attend avec beaucoup de questions.
sentences.translation: In the taxi, he waits with lots of questions.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Au bureau, le patron est à la porte.
sentences.translation: At the office, the boss is at the door.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Nicolas, un homme veut acheter notre magasin.
sentences.translation: Nicolas, a man wants to buy our shop.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Notre magasin ? Et vous, qu'est-ce que vous voulez ?
sentences.translation: Our shop? And what do you want?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Je ne veux pas. Mais il a beaucoup d'argent.
sentences.translation: I don't want to. But he has a lot of money.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Nicolas reste une heure avec son patron.
sentences.translation: Nicolas stays an hour with his boss.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils parlent, ils prennent un café, ils parlent encore.
sentences.translation: They talk, have a coffee, and talk some more.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il est déjà sept heures du soir.
sentences.translation: It's already seven in the evening.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: J'ai une solution.
sentences.translation: I have a solution.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Le magasin reste à vous. Et cet homme travaille avec nous.
sentences.translation: The shop stays yours. And that man works with us.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il aime la solution.
sentences.translation: He likes the solution.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, Nicolas prend le train pour la maison.
sentences.translation: In the evening, Nicolas takes the train home.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Quelle journée !
sentences.translation: What a day!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Une semaine après, l'homme travaille au magasin.
sentences.translation: A week later, the man is working at the shop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Et le magasin a beaucoup d'argent.
sentences.translation: And the shop has plenty of money.

questions.prompt: Who sends Nicolas a message?
What does the stranger want?
What is Nicolas's solution?
options: Keep the shop and have the man work with them

fr.story.la_bibliotheque.title: La bibliothèque
fr.story.la_bibliotheque.blurb: The library is closed, so Chloé goes into a bookshop — and meets a storyteller.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chloé aime les histoires.
sentences.translation: Chloé loves stories.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chaque samedi, elle va à la bibliothèque de la ville.
sentences.translation: Every Saturday, she goes to the city library.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: La bibliothèque ouvre à dix heures.
sentences.translation: The library opens at ten.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ce samedi, la porte est fermée.
sentences.translation: This Saturday, the door is closed.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pourquoi la porte est fermée ?
sentences.translation: Why is the door closed?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Une femme est à l'entrée.
sentences.translation: A woman is at the entrance.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Il y a de l'eau dans la maison. C'est ouvert demain.
sentences.translation: There's water in the building. It's open tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chloé va à la librairie de la rue.
sentences.translation: Chloé goes to the bookshop on the street.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Dans la librairie, il y a un homme avec une histoire.
sentences.translation: In the bookshop there is a man with a story.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonjour ! Vous aimez les héros ?
sentences.translation: Hello! Do you like heroes?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, beaucoup.
sentences.translation: Yes, very much.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: C'est mon histoire. L'histoire d'un héros de la ville.
sentences.translation: This is my story. The story of a hero of the city.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: C'est la vérité ?
sentences.translation: Is it true?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Non, ce n'est pas la vérité. C'est une histoire !
sentences.translation: No, it's not true. It's a story!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Chloé achète l'histoire.
sentences.translation: Chloé buys the story.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Elle reste au café de la place et elle a l'histoire sur la table.
sentences.translation: She sits in the café on the square with the story on the table.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le héros est un garçon de la ville avec un chien et un cheval.
sentences.translation: The hero is a boy from the city with a dog and a horse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il aime la liberté et la musique.
sentences.translation: He loves freedom and music.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le dimanche, c'est ouvert.
sentences.translation: On Sunday, it's open.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais Chloé reste à la maison avec son histoire.
sentences.translation: But Chloé stays at home with her story.

questions.prompt: Where does Chloé go every Saturday?
Who is the hero of the story?
options: A boy with a dog and a horse

questions.prompt: Why doesn't Chloé go to the library on Sunday, even though it's open?
options: Because she is absorbed in the story she bought

fr.story.le_voyage_de_paul.title: Le voyage de Paul
fr.story.le_voyage_de_paul.blurb: Paul arrives in a new city with a map — but can't find his hotel.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Paul fait un voyage.
sentences.translation: Paul is on a trip.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il va à l'aéroport en taxi.
sentences.translation: He goes to the airport by taxi.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À l'aéroport, il attend deux heures.
sentences.translation: At the airport, he waits two hours.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le soir, il est dans une autre ville.
sentences.translation: By evening, he is in another city.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Paul a une carte de la ville.
sentences.translation: Paul has a map of the city.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il veut aller à son hôtel.
sentences.translation: He wants to go to his hotel.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais la rue de l'hôtel n'est pas sur la carte !
sentences.translation: But the hotel's street isn't on the map!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Pardon, madame. Où est l'hôtel de la Gare ?
sentences.translation: Excuse me, madam. Where is the Hôtel de la Gare?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: C'est à gauche, puis à droite. Dix minutes.
sentences.translation: Left, then right. Ten minutes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Paul va à gauche, puis à droite.
sentences.translation: Paul goes left, then right.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mais il n'y a pas d'hôtel.
sentences.translation: But there's no hotel.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il y a un musée et un magasin.
sentences.translation: There's a museum and a shop.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Pardon, monsieur. L'hôtel de la Gare ?
sentences.translation: Excuse me, sir. The Hôtel de la Gare?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Ce n'est pas cette direction. C'est à droite, et encore à droite.
sentences.translation: It's not this way. Right, and right again.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Paul attend un moment.
sentences.translation: Paul stops for a moment.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il prend un taxi.
sentences.translation: He takes a taxi.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: L'hôtel de la Gare ? C'est ici, monsieur, derrière le musée !
sentences.translation: The Hôtel de la Gare? It's right here, sir, behind the museum!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: L'hôtel est à une minute du musée.
sentences.translation: The hotel is one minute from the museum.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Paul paie le taxi.
sentences.translation: Paul pays the taxi.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À l'hôtel, il mange du poulet et il boit un thé.
sentences.translation: At the hotel, he eats chicken and drinks a tea.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Demain, pas de carte. Je prends un taxi !
sentences.translation: Tomorrow, no map. I'm taking a taxi!

questions.prompt: Where does Paul want to go?
Where is the hotel really?
Why does Paul say he'll take a taxi tomorrow?
options: Because the map didn't help him find his way
Because the hotel is very far away

fr.story.le_restaurant_du_samedi.title: Le restaurant du samedi
fr.story.le_restaurant_du_samedi.blurb: A happy Saturday dinner — until Lucas realises he has no money.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le samedi soir, Inès et Lucas vont au restaurant.
sentences.translation: On Saturday evening, Inès and Lucas go to a restaurant.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: C'est le restaurant de la place, près de la gare.
sentences.translation: It's the restaurant on the square, near the station.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Bonsoir ! Une table pour deux ?
sentences.translation: Good evening! A table for two?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, merci.
sentences.translation: Yes, thank you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils prennent une table près de la porte.
sentences.translation: They take a table near the door.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Inès prend du poulet avec du riz.
sentences.translation: Inès has chicken with rice.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Lucas prend du poisson, des œufs et du fromage.
sentences.translation: Lucas has fish, eggs and cheese.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils boivent du jus de pomme et de l'eau.
sentences.translation: They drink apple juice and water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ils parlent de leur semaine et de leurs voyages.
sentences.translation: They talk about their week and their travels.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: À dix heures, ils veulent payer.
sentences.translation: At ten, they want to pay.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Voici le prix, monsieur.
sentences.translation: Here is the bill, sir.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh non ! Je n'ai pas d'argent.
sentences.translation: Oh no! I have no money.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Pas d'argent ? Pourquoi ?
sentences.translation: No money? Why?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: L'argent est à la maison, sur la table.
sentences.translation: The money is at home, on the table.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Ça va, Lucas. Je paie pour toi.
sentences.translation: It's fine, Lucas. I'll pay for you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Inès paie le prix.
sentences.translation: Inès pays the bill.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Merci, Inès. Demain, je paie au restaurant.
sentences.translation: Thank you, Inès. Tomorrow, I'm paying at the restaurant.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oui, demain, c'est toi.
sentences.translation: Yes, tomorrow it's your turn.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Le dimanche, Lucas est à la porte d'Inès.
sentences.translation: On Sunday, Lucas is at Inès's door.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Il a un cadeau pour Inès.
sentences.translation: He has a present for Inès.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Lucas, c'est quoi ?
sentences.translation: Lucas, what is it?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: C'est pour la confiance.
sentences.translation: It's for trusting me.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: C'est un fromage.
sentences.translation: It's a cheese.

questions.prompt: Where do Inès and Lucas go on Saturday evening?
options: To the restaurant on the square, near the station

questions.prompt: Who pays for dinner?
Why does Lucas bring Inès a present?
options: To thank her for trusting him and paying for him
Because he wants to buy the restaurant
